name: cmsskim-tt-p0-v1

steps.cmd: pip install -q 'uproot>=5.3,<6' 'awkward>=2.6,<3' numpy fsspec aiohttp requests
cd /work && python -m py_compile cmsskim.py test_cmsskim.py && python -m unittest -v test_cmsskim > /out/tests.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/tests.txt; exit $rc
cd /work && sha256sum cmsskim.py test_cmsskim.py PREREG-CMSTOPO-v0.1.md | tee /out/sha256.txt && pip freeze > /out/versions.txt

cd /work && OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 timeout 20700 python cmsskim.py --sample tt --part 0 --nparts 4 --max-minutes 320 --step 20000 --out-dir /out > /out/run.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; grep -E '^CMSSKIM_' /out/run.txt | tail -n 60; tail -n 25 /out/run.txt; exit $rc
